item.title: Eli Lilly Tirzepatide Compounding Impurity Warning | Ultragenyx DTX301 Phase 3 | Novo Holdings Asset Decline - BioMed Nexus
item.description: Eli Lilly flags a novel impurity in all compounded tirzepatide-B12 samples, calling for a nationwide recall. Plus Ultragenyx DTX301 hits its Phase 3 ammonia endpoint in OTC deficiency, Novo Holdings reports a 34% asset collapse, and Pfizer shuts down its Ignite incubator.

item.title: Sana Biotechnology T1D Cure Data ATTD 2026 | Lilly Tirzepatide Compounding Crackdown | ACIP Kennedy Meeting - BioMed Nexus
item.description: Sana Biotechnology reports 14-month islet cell durability without immunosuppression at ATTD 2026, validating a Type 1 diabetes cure thesis. Plus Lilly's tirzepatide-B12 impurity warning escalates the compounding crackdown, ACIP convenes under Kennedy appointees, and NVIDIA GTC launches Lilly's $1B AI factory.

item.title: Roche Lilly GPU Arms Race GTC 2026 | China First Commercial BCI | ACIP Kennedy Meeting Vaccine Policy - BioMed Nexus
item.description: Roche deploys 3,500+ Blackwell GPUs and Lilly showcases LillyPod at NVIDIA GTC 2026 as pharma's AI infrastructure war escalates. Plus China approves the world's first commercial brain-computer interface, ACIP convenes under Kennedy appointees, and Rhythm's Imcivree PDUFA lands Friday.

item.title: Bicycle Shelves Padcev Challenger • Aldeyra's 3rd CRL • Jensen Huang's $1T Flex - BioMed Nexus
item.description: Bicycle Therapeutics cuts 30% of staff and shelves its Nectin-4 Padcev challenger after FDA rejects the Duravelo-2 trial design. Plus Aldeyra receives a third CRL for reproxalap, Rhythm's Imcivree PDUFA lands Friday, and Lilly's oral GLP-1 orforglipron enters its decision window.

item.title: BridgeBio Strengthens LGMD Case at MDA • Stryker Hit by Cyberattack • Vima Adds $40M - BioMed Nexus
item.description: Johnson & Johnson wins FDA approval for Icotyde, the first oral IL-23 receptor antagonist for psoriasis, beating Sotyktu head-to-head. Plus Gossamer Bio cuts 48% of staff after seralutinib misses its Phase 3 PAH endpoint, and Rhythm's Imcivree PDUFA for acquired hypothalamic obesity lands tomorrow.

item.title: Rhythm Imcivree HO Approval | Lilly Retatrutide Phase 3 Triple Agonist | GLP-1 Metabolic Monopoly - BioMed Nexus
item.description: FDA approves Rhythm's Imcivree for acquired hypothalamic obesity with a broader-than-expected label covering age 4 and older. Plus Lilly's retatrutide delivers 16.8% weight loss in its first Phase 3 diabetes trial with no plateau, building pharma's most dominant metabolic franchise.

item.title: Four FDA Approvals in One Week • Novartis Drops $3B • The Obesity War Just Got a New Front - BioMed Nexus
item.description: Novo Nordisk's Wegovy HD wins the fastest GLP-1 approval in history under a 54-day CNPV review, delivering 20.7% weight loss. Plus Novartis pays $2B upfront for a PI3Kα breast cancer asset, and four FDA approvals land in a single week alongside Lilly's retatrutide Phase 3 data.

item.title: Pfizer's Lyme Vaccine Misses But Files Anyway • Apogee's Twice-a-Year Eczema Shot - BioMed Nexus
item.description: Pfizer and Valneva's Lyme vaccine shows 73% efficacy but misses its statistical endpoint, and both companies plan to file anyway. Plus Apogee's zumilokibart maintains eczema response with just two injections per year, and Insmed clears a critical ARIKAYCE post-marketing hurdle.
